items.description: Table Mountain is an iconic flat-topped mountain overlooking Cape Town, forming the heart of a biodiverse national park.
facts: Part of Table Mountain National Park

items.description: The Cederberg Mountains are famous for their dramatic sandstone rock formations and ancient San rock art.
The Indian Ocean coast of South Africa is characterized by warm waters, beautiful beaches, and subtropical coastal forests.
The Atlantic coast features rugged scenery, dramatic cliffs, and the cold waters of the Benguela Current.
The Karoo is a vast, semi-desert region known for its wide open spaces and unique succulent vegetation.
Tsitsikamma is a protected area on the Garden Route, featuring ancient forests, dramatic coastlines, and river gorges.
Lake Teko is a notable wetland and freshwater environment supporting various bird species.
Uphole Lake is an important natural water body, serving as a sanctuary for local avian wildlife.
Addo Elephant National Park is a premier wildlife reserve, particularly known for its thriving population of African elephants.
The Orange River Mouth is a significant wetland and estuary area forming the border between South Africa and Namibia.
